about_the_game:
Attention astronauts! Get ready to search the stars in style with the KR Retro Starship Tileset! Kokoro Reflections has created the perfect MV/MZ-sized tileset to fill your sci-fi game with cold steel walkways and orange highlights. Build cargo ships run with a small crew, science ships setting off to learn about distant planets, passenger ships where function rules over form, and more with this pack! A1, A2, A3, A4, A5, and 4 B sheets cover exterior and interior tiles to make full spaceships. Give your players an overview of the ship with an exterior establishing shot that shows where different vents and airlocks are, and switch to the bridge map with a large octagonal window looking out at the stars and computer stations tracking the ship’s current location and possible threats. Create claustrophobic hallways with grate floors that lead to the med bay with its shelves of books and medicines, the science lab with leafy greens growing in hydroponic units, and small crew bedrooms where beds and small shower units offer reprieve from the dirty work of moving crates and maintaining the ship’s equipment.

This pack also includes a starry parallax image you can use as a backdrop for your massive ships, along with 10 character sprites for doors and smaller shuttles. Keep your heroes safe from the vacuum of space with solid steel airlocks and large bay doors that can be opened only when necessary, and show computers that can be interacted with thanks to scrolling text on the monitors. Pick up the KR Retro Starship Tileset and build all the spaceships your game could possibly need!


Contents:

Floor tiles:

Water tiles with three floor edges
Glowing white floor with three edges
Waterfall
Plain gray floor
Three strange geometry floors
One plain floor with orange lit edge
4 grate floors
4 tiled floors
2 tables (lit and unlit)
Two glowing floor accents
1 hole tile with glowing edge

Walls:

Walls to match most flooring
Autotile windows (dark and lit, best used for in-wall displays)
16 additional walls with sci-fi details, panels, lights, etc

Also included:

Stairs to match floor tiles
Warning strips, lights, grates and other details for floors
Door arches
Windows (transparent, star pattern, tinted)
Airlock (with animations)
Narrow and wide doors (with animations)
Pipes and wall decor
Displays and wall panels
Specimen capsules (whole and broken)
Medical beds
Science and medical devices (scanners, tablets, test tubes, small boxes, ID cards, microscope, etc)
Hydroponics
Shelving units with medical, books, plants, houseware items, etc (with and without front glass)
Glowing pillars in several sizes, lit and unlit
Beds
Chairs (some attached at the sides)
Bathroom tiles, with shower built-in and optional shower door
Poster collection
Food items – trays, drinks, with fallen/wrecked/scattered versions depending on type
Escape pod (with interior)
Shuttle (with interior)
Crates
Ship exterior pieces (see screenshots) Includes shadowed and non-shadowed version for parallax mapping.

Events and Animations:

Airlock (left and right handed, lit and unlit)
Large bay door that fits shuttle, interior and exterior, plus transparent version you can customize
Wide and narrow door animations
Engine glow (also fits escape pod)
Escape pod door
Monitor display data
Shuttle

* Sample map included!


Terms of Use:

This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.
OK to be used in Commercial projects
Contents can be edited
OK for use in games with gore
OK for use in adult-rated games
